description: On a walk that begins and ends at Mornington Crescent station, discover how housing, industry, education, entertainment and social reform have shaped the surrounding area. Along the way, explore how buildings and public spaces have been demolished, adapted and given new lives, revealing layers of Camden's changing social history.

factsheet.heading: About the walk
paragraphs: This walk begins and ends at Mornington Crescent station and explores a less familiar side of Camden. Through housing, industry, education, entertainment and social reform, it traces how the area has changed over time. Along the way, we look at buildings and public spaces that have been created, adapted, demolished and given new lives, and at the people and ideas that shaped them.

factsheet.heading: Golden Key Academy
paragraphs:
The Golden Key Academy is a course training up insightful and engaging guides dedicated to explaining London and bringing its many stories to life. This tour is part of a wider collection of tours created by Golden Key Academy guides for the Open House Festival celebrating their conclusion of the eight month course.  Further information on the Golden Key Academy can be found here https://open-city.org.uk/golden-key-academy
If you would like to attend this tour, please ensure you have booked a ticket before turning up.
